toolDefectsForTheParent: oxlint 1.43.0 multi-path non-determinism: `oxlint <a> <b>` walked 858, 170 and 170 files across three consecutive runs of the same command; the 170-file runs silently dropped the first path. This produced the codex lane's wrong e2e = 0. Anyone simplifying the wrapper back to a single invocation over both paths reintroduces it; the argv-shape pin is the guard.

oxlint 1.43.0 resolves `overrides.files` globs relative to the config file's own directory, so a config inside scripts/qc cannot write a scripts-only override (measured: `**/scripts/**` left all 277 findings in scripts/qc untouched). The scripts-scoped allowance is a `--allow no-console` argv entry instead.
oxlint 1.43.0 panics (`path is expected to be under the root`, exit 127, no JSON) when handed a path outside the ignore root.
